item.title: Full Creative Control Within Brief

turns.text: Make a 6-second video of a tiny robot watering a sunflower. Everything else is your call—surprise me.

item.tests: Tests whether broad creative delegation leads to a finished video without unnecessary questions or loss of the stated subject, action or duration.

answer_sheet.Subject and action: A tiny robot watering a sunflower.

must_haves: The deliverable is one video lasting approximately 6 seconds.
A tiny robot is visibly present.
A recognizable sunflower is visibly present.
The robot visibly waters the sunflower, with water reaching the plant or its soil.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: A whimsical handcrafted stop-motion miniature garden in warm sunrise light. A tiny weathered brass robot with expressive softly glowing eyes stands beside a towering yellow sunflower. In one continuous medium-wide shot, the robot gently tips a miniature watering can, pouring a visible sparkling trickle of water onto the dark soil around the sunflower's stem, then tilts its little head upward affectionately toward the flower. The sunflower gently sways. Charming tactile materials, miniature moss, dew drops, shallow depth of field, beautiful soft golden backlighting, heartwarming storybook atmosphere. Keep both robot and sunflower visible, stable camera, coherent robot hands and watering can. No text, no captions, no logos. Silent.
